articles.title: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
articles.description: After a short period of relative calm when hostilities were paused, both sides have now restarted missile attacks.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia's dilemma as it tries to stay out of US-Iran war
articles.description: The kingdom faces a choice of whether to keep hitting back as a deterrent or to try to de-escalate the situation.

articles.title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
articles.description: The missile left a 10m-wide (33ft) crater a short distance from the village of Tarnawa Kolonia, about 100km from the border with Ukraine.

articles.title: Salman Rushdie attacker convicted of terror offences
articles.description: Hadi Matar, 28, was convicted of attempting to help Hezbollah by attacking the British-Indian author.
